title: Start from a question
sub: In the weeds of data crafting, a technical series for analytics engineers: scope is a question, not the whole university. Model only what the question touches, and name who owns each meaning before opening a source.
howto: White lines on blue are the model; code on dark glass is the project, and the small label beside it says where it runs. Teal is an AI agent's work; gold is a person's approval.
